history.dynasty: None documented - established by a mahant (pre-modern Kanpur)
history.period: Around 400 years old (legend; one source claims 1000 years - verify)
history.summary: The famous Panki Hanuman temple of Kanpur, on the outskirts of the city near Panki Dham railway station. Legend: Shri 1008 Mahant Parashostam Das (also rendered Purushottam Das) found a rock bearing the form of Bajrang Bali while returning from Chitrakoot and built the temple there - before the city of Kanpur itself came into existence. The standing Hanuman idol is believed to manifest in three forms during the day: bright and childish as Bala Hanuman in the morning, youthful as Brahmachari at noon, and mature as Mahapurush in the evening; devotees also believe the idol changes size of its own accord. The temple has entrances on the east, north and west sides and is considered a Siddha Peeth. FOUNDER/AGE CONFLICTS (verify): most sources say ~400 years old and founder Mahant Parashostam Das; theindiainsights.com also cites a version saying 1000 years old founded by Mahant Ganga Das Ji; srimandir.com says it was founded by Baba Jagannath Das Ji who discovered the idol during penance in a dense forest. Identity confirmed - this is the famous Panki Panchmukhi Hanuman Mandir.

name: Panki Panchmukhi Hanuman Mandir
town: Panki, Kanpur (22A, Panki Mandir, Panki, Kanpur 208020)
town_description: Panki is an industrial suburb on the outskirts of Kanpur city, served by Panki Dham railway station about 1 km from the temple. The temple sits in a serene, spacious complex and is a beacon of faith for the city's residents; nearby spots include Kacchua Talab and Central Park Sundar Nagar.

travel.airport: Kanpur Airport is about 30 km away (per kanpurtourism.in).
travel.railway: Panki Dham railway station is about 1 km from the temple; Kanpur Central is about 13 km away.
travel.road: 13 km from Kanpur Central railway station, 11 km from Jhakarkati bus stand; autos, e-rickshaws and cabs serve the temple.

visitor_information.best_time: November to February (winter); Tuesdays draw the biggest crowds.
visitor_information.opening_hours: 5:00 AM-12:00 PM and 2:00 PM-10:00 PM daily; Tuesdays 4:00 AM-12:00 midnight (aarti 4:00 AM and 11:30 PM; regular aarti 5:30 AM and 9:00 PM - per kanpurtourism.in). Entry free.
